sentences.en: Wash his wound with this antiseptic.
sentences.zh: 用这个防腐剂清洗他的伤口。

sentences.en: The effective application of antiseptics is an important matter in the prevention of hospital infections.
sentences.zh: 正确使用防腐剂是预防医院感染的重要事项。

sentences.en: The doctor applied some antiseptic to the cut before bandaging it.
sentences.zh: 医生在包扎伤口前用了一些消毒液。

senses.zh: 杀菌的；防腐的；极为干净整洁的；冷漠的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：anti（抗）+sept（烂）+ic（…的） →防腐的
